# FLAC regression audio

`flac-transient-24.wav` is frame 145 (4096 stereo frames, 48 kHz, 24-bit PCM)
from the original analytic six-track example generated by this repository's
`examples/make_project.rs` and renderer. It contains no human voice recording,
licensed song, or third-party sample. These generated sample bytes are dedicated
to the public domain under CC0-1.0.

This real mixed transient exposed a pathological multi-gigabit predictive Rice
frame in flacenc 0.5.1. The regression checks the bounded verbatim fallback,
sample-for-sample PCM identity, and a populated FLAC MD5 checksum.
